note: Stroke names in writing order, following the standard school stroke order (现代汉语通用字笔顺规范), checked against cjklib's strokeorder.csv and the stroke shapes in Make Me a Hanzi. A part can change a stroke when it moves: 女 ends in 横 alone but in 提 on the left of 好; 木 ends in 捺 alone but in 点 on the left of 林. null = not yet checked, shown without labels. Needs a review by a Chinese teacher before release.
